correctness.rationale: The explicit dual embedding bounds lambda2 <= B/D*. Its norm and edge constraints are algebraically verified, and the optimizer uses a clipped vertex-location parameter. Constructed rates have budget B, the scalar Fiedler vector and simplex contrasts at eigenvalue B/D*, and all remaining quotient/transverse eigenvalues at least B/D*. A tridiagonal irreducible M-matrix with a strictly positive eigenvector establishes quotient eigen ordering; dual complementary slackness and full simplex span force each edge conductance uniquely. The nonnegative c=max(0,(lambda-a)/r) covers all phase boundaries. A 1225-case finite eigenvalue check supports but does not replace the proof.
